VBO:0200362.summary: Veterinarian Ana Oliveira describes the Chug as spirited, affectionate and keen on human company. Her account notes a playful, outgoing manner alongside boldness and a stubborn streak. This is the Chihuahua–Pug cross, with alert barking among the habits she describes.
VBO:0200362.shortDescription: An affectionate Chihuahua–Pug cross, described by veterinarian Ana Oliveira as spirited, playful and sometimes stubborn.

sources.title: DogZone — Chug, original veterinary account by Ana Oliveira
sources.evidence: Direct attributed spirited/affectionate/company-loving, playful/outgoing/bold/stubborn character and alert barking. Both final descriptions retain author attribution.
